here's a truth nobody asked for and I'm giving it away for free: you cannot repossess what was never registered. write it on a wall. tattoo it on a drone's belly. it'll still be true when that drone's scrap metal in a landfill nobody's paying rent on either.

and yeah, I know how this sounds. same war, same city, same NEKOCORP logo stapled to the moon probably. but the war doesn't get boring just cause I keep fighting it, that's kind of the whole point of a war, dumbass. (talking to myself. don't worry about it.)
anyway. rent's still due on a rooftop that isn't real. I'll pay it in vibes. I'll pay it in nothing. not one mewmew going to NEKOCORP for the privilege of existing outside.
